description: This file defines the SliceFixture class used for integration testing in a .NET project. It sets up an in-memory database, manages dependency injection, and provides utility methods for executing scoped actions, invoking MediatR requests, and database operations within tests.

classes.name: SliceFixture
classes.description: A fixture class for setting up and managing an isolated test environment, including in-memory database instance, dependency injection, and utility methods for database and mediator interactions.

methods.name: SliceFixture
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the in-memory database and dependency injection container, and ensures the database is created.

methods.name: GetDbContext
methods.description: Retrieves the current ConduitContext instance from the service provider.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Deletes the in-memory database file when the fixture is disposed.

methods.name: ExecuteScopeAsync
methods.description: Executes an asynchronous action within a new dependency injection scope.

methods.name: ExecuteScopeAsync<T>
methods.description: Executes an asynchronous action returning a result within a new scope.

methods.name: SendAsync<TResponse>
methods.description: Sends a request via MediatR within a scope and returns the response.

methods.name: SendAsync
methods.description: Sends a request via MediatR within a scope without expecting a response.

methods.name: ExecuteDbContextAsync
methods.description: Executes an asynchronous action involving the ConduitContext within a scope.

methods.name: ExecuteDbContextAsync<T>
methods.description: Executes an asynchronous action involving the ConduitContext that returns a result.

methods.name: InsertAsync
methods.description: Adds entities to the context and saves changes asynchronously.
